tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Gogroup's main color — 'always present as the protagonist'. Light-theme accent. White on it 6.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-lime
tokens.usage: Gogroup lime. Color blocks and charts only; never white text on it — use text #333333 (8.3:1).

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Gogroup amber. Color blocks and charts; text on it in #333333 (6.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Gogroup orange. Blocks only; white on it is 4.3:1 (large text only). Don't pair with red or pink: they vibrate.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Gogroup red. Blocks and large fills; white on it 4.5:1. Status text uses danger instead.

tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: Gogroup pink. Blocks only; white on it 4.4:1 (large text only).

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Gogroup sky blue. Blocks and charts; text on it in #333333 (6.0:1), never white (2.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Gogroup white, part of the official palette.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards (the brandbook's #f5f5f5 in light); also the fill of text inputs and selects, so fields sit slightly recessed inside a surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar and the sticky header (header at 90% with backdrop blur).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav links and outline buttons; table header band; evidence chips; empty track of the destination bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: card outlines, card-title dividers, table row dividers, input and outline-button borders.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-2 — the brandbook's ink #333333 in light (12.6:1 on white, 11.6:1 on bg). Also the text color on lime, amber and sky blocks.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, table headers, timestamps, IDs. 5.6:1 on surface (light), 6.9:1 (dark). Also the neutral-badge text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The interface's one action hue — Gogroup blue in light: logo mark, primary buttons, links, active nav item, focus border on inputs. Dark keeps the app's lighter #6b9bff, since brand blue is 2.6:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Active nav-link fill, selected table row, icon tiles (lot card). Carries accent text at 5.9:1 (light).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Positive outcome: Liberado automático, Aprovado, Devolvido ao lote, protected amount, Approve button fill.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of ok badges and of a decision panel with no failed rules.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a human: Aguardando aprovação, Hoje urgency, money at risk, alert-severity rule icon.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warn badges and of a decision panel with failed rules; 'Modo local' badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Money must not leave: Retirado do lote, Recusado, Imediata urgency, Crítica severity, mismatched values, form errors, < 2h countdown, Refuse-confirm button fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges (e.g. 'canal não oficial').

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state, same value as accent: Conferido, aguarda aprovador; Aprovação severity; human-approved stat.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges (same value as accent-soft).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges (rule codes, Normal urgency, Enviado ao banco), paired with muted text.

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text on solid accent, ok and danger buttons (text-white in the source). 6.9:1 on light accent. Fails in dark: 2.6:1 on dark accent, 2.0:1 on dark ok — see README, Known gaps.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One h1 per page (text-xl font-semibold), followed by a muted body-sm line.

styles.name: empty-title
styles.usage: Empty-state heading and large figures in lot cards and the detail header (text-lg).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name beside the shield mark (font-semibold tracking-tight).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: h2 inside a card's title bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Títulos dos lotes ainda abertos, conferidos contra ERP, Compras, NF-e, DDA e extratos.
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, nav links, form fields, paragraphs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasised cells and list titles; active nav link.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines, table headers, stat details — usually in muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels inside the detail panel (uppercase tracking-wide, muted).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: 'em breve' tag on disabled nav items (uppercase).

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: KPI value in a Stat card. Always tabular-nums; colored by tone.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Title amount in the detail header and the countdown in lot cards. Tabular.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Title IDs and lot codes in tables and headers.

styles.name: evidence
styles.usage: Evidence chips under a failed rule, on surface-2.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding (py-0.5).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badge rows and icon+label pairs; nav item stack gap.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding; small button vertical padding (py-1.5).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; gap between buttons; input padding.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in nav links; icon tile padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; card-title vertical padding; small button horizontal padding; grid gap between stats.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; card-title horizontal padding; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections; page gutter from md up; login card padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Evidence chips (rounded).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, badges (rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Nav links, inner panels, icon tiles, rule rows (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards — the outermost container (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The destination progress bar.
